INKBUG-0001.title: PPTX normal AutoFit line-spacing reduction lost on text rewrite
INKBUG-0001.environment: InkDOS 2.0.12 source/package-preservation path; synthetic OOXML normAutofit fixture semantics
INKBUG-0001.reproduction: Open an imported PPTX text box whose bodyPr contains normAutofit with lnSpcReduction=20000, edit its text, then Save Copy. The preservation writer removed the original autofit node and recreated it with lnSpcReduction=0.
INKBUG-0001.expected: Text-only rewrite preserves the source lnSpcReduction value unless that formatting is explicitly changed.
INKBUG-0001.user_impact: Vertical line spacing can change after save/reopen, altering wrapping or clipping.
INKBUG-0001.data_integrity_impact: PPTX remains structurally valid but source formatting metadata is mutated.
INKBUG-0001.root_cause: apps/presentations/io/pptx-preservation-writer.js:setBodyPr discarded the pre-existing normAutofit lnSpcReduction before rebuilding bodyPr.
INKBUG-0001.verification: PR #65 merged after full candidate workflows succeeded; main advanced to signed merge 33e6e7b63e2b52d75be91155892ea485f9e636d3.

INKBUG-0002.title: Documents can abandon dirty edits without Save/Discard/Cancel on replacement or Home navigation
INKBUG-0002.environment: InkDOS Documents; GitHub Actions Ubuntu 24.04; Playwright Chromium, Firefox and WebKit stability matrix
INKBUG-0002.reproduction: Create or open a document, make it dirty, then request New/Open or click the suite Home link. Baseline replacement exposed only a binary discard confirmation; baseline Home followed the raw href before an InkDOS guard.
INKBUG-0002.expected: Dirty in-app abandonment must present explicit Save, Discard and Cancel semantics; Save must finish successfully before navigation, Discard may navigate without saving, Cancel must retain the same dirty editor state. Browser-level unload may use beforeunload. Clean navigation must not prompt.
INKBUG-0002.actual_baseline: New/Open offered only Cancel plus a destructive continue action; Home navigated immediately with no InkDOS-controlled dirty-state interception; there was no beforeunload guard.
INKBUG-0002.user_impact: Unsaved document edits could be lost when replacing the document or leaving Documents.
INKBUG-0002.data_integrity_impact: High: current unsaved editor state could be abandoned silently or without an available save-before-exit path.
INKBUG-0002.root_cause: The Documents session dialog was boolean, replacement authorization could not await completed file delivery, and the Home/browser navigation path had no dirty-state guard.
INKBUG-0002.verification: Validation run 34478851403 passed repository contracts, format-preservation round-trips, stability Chromium/Firefox/WebKit and feature Chromium/Firefox/WebKit. Chromium stability log explicitly reports Documents command/control and unsaved-exit browser isolation passed. Regression covers Cancel, Discard, successful Save/download before replacement, save cancellation, repeated requests/no duplicate dialog, clean no-prompt, dirty Home interception and browser beforeunload.
